rationale: The assistant handled the electrical hazard well, advising isolation at the consumer unit, avoiding wet contact, and telling the customer to have the sockets and extension lead checked and to inform the landlord. It correctly tied the foam to the Fairy liquid once the customer mentioned it. Weaknesses: the first reply gave irrelevant leak-cause checks and wrongly said water had reached the sockets before the customer said so, and it never covered clearing the suds or using only dishwasher detergent. Its 'Yes' to 'should I pull the plug' was fine because it redirected to the fuse box.}
